legal_privacy_subtitle: How WalletAI handles account, financial, AI, and app data.
legal_terms_subtitle: Conditions for using WalletAI and its AI features.
legal_privacy_account_text: To create and manage your account, WalletAI may process data such as name, surname, email address, user identifier, and app preferences like language, currency, and country.
legal_privacy_financial_text: WalletAI lets you enter personal financial data, including transactions, categories, accounts, balances, notes, and receipt images when you choose to upload them.
legal_privacy_ai_text: Messages sent to the AI chat and relevant financial context may be processed to generate summaries, explanations, calculations, and suggestions. AI responses are informational only. WalletAI does not provide professional financial, legal, or tax advice, and you remain responsible for verifying information before making decisions.
legal_privacy_technical_text: WalletAI may process technical data needed for app operation and security, such as app logs, device data, errors, app version, and diagnostic information.
legal_privacy_deletion_text: You can request deletion from Settings > Delete account, or from the web deletion resource prepared for Google Play. Deletion includes the WalletAI account and associated user data such as transactions, categories, financial accounts, preferences, and AI chat messages where present. Some limited records may be retained only where required for law, security, fraud prevention, or technical backup integrity.
legal_privacy_contact_text: For privacy, support, or deletion requests, contact Spiloss AI Labs at spilossailabs@gmail.com. Include the email address used for your WalletAI account and the package name com.spiloss.walletai.
legal_terms_personal_text: WalletAI is designed for personal use and helps you organize income, expenses, accounts, and financial habits.
legal_terms_advice_text: WalletAI is an informational and support tool. It does not provide professional financial, investment, tax, legal, accounting, or regulated advice. AI outputs, statistics, charts, and suggestions are not instructions to buy, sell, invest, borrow, or make any financial decision.
legal_terms_data_text: You are responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and freshness of the data you enter. Financial decisions are yours alone. Before relying on any information, verify it and consult a qualified professional when needed.
legal_terms_plus_text: Some features, including higher AI limits or advanced tools, may require a Plus subscription. Prices, limits, and availability are shown before purchase.
legal_terms_ai_text: AI features may generate incomplete, outdated, or incorrect responses. You agree not to submit unlawful, harmful, abusive, or sensitive third-party content to the AI chat. You should not enter payment card numbers, government identification numbers, or credentials into chat messages.
legal_terms_liability_text: To the extent permitted by law, WalletAI and Spiloss AI Labs are not liable for financial decisions, losses, missed opportunities, inaccurate user-entered data, AI errors, temporary unavailability, third-party provider issues, or indirect damages arising from use of the app.
legal_terms_contact_text: For questions about these Terms, support, privacy, or deletion requests, contact Spiloss AI Labs at spilossailabs@gmail.com. Include the package name com.spiloss.walletai when relevant.
register_legal_required: You must accept the Terms of use and Privacy Policy.
register_validation_password_min_length: Password must be at least 6 characters long.

legal_privacy_overview_text: This Privacy Policy explains how WalletAI, provided by Spiloss AI Labs, processes information when you create an account, use personal finance features, interact with the AI chat, or use related services. WalletAI is a personal finance support tool and is not an authorized financial advisor.
legal_privacy_data_text: We may process the following data: email address and account authentication data; profile information needed to operate the app; transactions entered by you; categories; financial accounts created by you; balances, notes, receipt images if you upload them, and related metadata; language, currency, country, theme, and other preferences; messages and prompts sent to the AI chat; minimum technical data needed for security, diagnostics, fraud prevention, and app operation; and advertising identifiers or ad interaction data if Google AdMob banner or rewarded ads are enabled in the future.
legal_privacy_usage_text: We use data to provide login and account security, save and sync your information, show transactions and statistics, generate charts and insights, personalize language and currency, provide AI analysis, diagnose errors, protect the service, improve app quality, manage subscriptions or limits where applicable, and support advertising monetization if ads are enabled.
legal_privacy_third_parties_text: WalletAI uses Supabase for authentication, database, and storage infrastructure. AI requests may be processed by the AI provider used by the app to generate responses. If advertising is enabled in the future, Google and AdMob may process advertising-related data according to their policies. These providers process data only as needed to deliver app functionality, security, analytics, support, or advertising where active.
legal_privacy_ads_text: WalletAI may include subscriptions and, in the future, AdMob banner or rewarded ads. If ads are enabled, advertising data such as ad identifiers, impressions, interactions, and approximate technical information may be processed to show, measure, and protect ads. Where required, consent choices will be requested before personalized advertising.
legal_privacy_security_text: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal and financial data. Data is transmitted using secure connections where supported by the providers. No app can guarantee absolute security, so you should keep your login credentials private and use a secure device.
legal_privacy_retention_text: We keep account and app data while your account is active or as needed to provide the service. After a deletion request is verified, associated account data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except where limited retention is necessary for legal obligations, security, fraud prevention, dispute handling, backups, or technical logs.
legal_privacy_rights_text: Depending on your location, you may request access, correction, deletion, portability, restriction, objection, or withdrawal of consent where applicable. You can update many preferences in the app. For privacy requests, use the deletion flow in Settings or the web deletion resource and include the email address used for your WalletAI account.
legal_terms_overview_text: These Terms govern your use of WalletAI, a personal finance management app provided by Spiloss AI Labs. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to use WalletAI responsibly and in accordance with these Terms.
legal_terms_allowed_text: WalletAI is intended for personal finance tracking, organization, statistics, AI-assisted explanations, and related support features. You must use the app only for lawful purposes and provide information that you have the right to use.
legal_terms_abuse_text: You must not attempt to disrupt, reverse engineer, overload, bypass limits, misuse subscriptions or ads, access another user account, upload malicious content, or use WalletAI in a way that harms users, providers, or the service.
legal_terms_subscriptions_ads_text: WalletAI may offer free and paid features. Plus or other paid plans may change limits, AI quotas, themes, or advanced tools. Prices and conditions are shown before purchase. WalletAI may also include banner or rewarded advertising in the future, including Google AdMob, where allowed by law and platform rules.
legal_terms_changes_text: Spiloss AI Labs may update, improve, suspend, limit, or discontinue parts of WalletAI, including features, limits, AI providers, subscriptions, or ads. Important changes may be communicated in the app, store listing, or updated legal documents.
delete_account_request_subtitle: Request deletion of your WalletAI account and associated data. This app currently creates a guided request; deletion is completed after ownership verification.
delete_account_data_text: A verified deletion request covers your WalletAI account and associated data, including transactions, categories, financial accounts, preferences such as language and currency, and AI chat messages or conversations where present.
delete_account_retention_text: Some data may be retained only where necessary for legal obligations, security, fraud prevention, dispute handling, backups, or technical logs. Temporary account disabling is not treated as account deletion.
delete_account_process_text: Open the email request, send it from or mention the email address used for your WalletAI account, and contact spilossailabs@gmail.com. Spiloss AI Labs may request verification before deleting data.
delete_account_web_text: This page can be hosted as the public Google Play data deletion URL. Users can request account and data deletion without reinstalling the app by contacting spilossailabs@gmail.com.
